content:
I don't use TikTok myself, but from secondhand information, the platform seems to have become a massive database of dubious advice. Recently, there are even tutorial videos telling people to put their iPhones in the freezer to cool them down...

Engadget cited one of these examples.

Of course, you absolutely should not do this. The most likely outcome is that condensation will form inside the phone's components, whether it's left in the freezer or after you take it out. There's also the risk of thermal shock, and lithium batteries are particularly sensitive to thermal shock.

Over the past few weeks, the UK has been hit by a heatwave (by UK standards, of course), and reports indicate that phone repair shops have seen a noticeable increase in cases of damage caused by customers following this kind of advice.

Apple's official recommendation is that if your iPhone overheats, you should place it in a cool environment and let it cool down naturally. However, you should not leave it in a car. Even in the glove compartment, the temperature on a hot day can be high enough to cause damage or even cause the battery to catch fire.
